g.text: Annual Education Spending per Student (Rupees, log scale)
Weighted distribution of annual household education spending per student (PSLM 2019–20)
Top-Decile Students in Rural Punjab Spend Rs 30,000 Annually — 4.5x the Median

Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: Students (ed_total > 0) in rural Punjab (n = 9,173; 3 students outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 excluded). Weighted by household survey weights (hhweight).
